contract.title: Simplification Review
contract.plan_section_71: Each project maintains simplification-debt.md; valid deferred simplifications are recorded and not repeatedly rediscovered.
contract.acceptance: A qualified coding task records one bounded simplify/reuse/defer/no_action outcome, with verification and debt linkage where applicable, through existing ledger/telemetry/project state.

implementation.verification_gate: simplify/reuse require verification=passed; defer/no_action remain safe bounded records

classification.integration: PROVEN — explicit CLI boundary invoked after qualified verification; no parallel orchestration
classification.automated_evidence: PROVEN — 68 relevant Python tests, including contract enum, outcome, dedupe, resolve, corruption, safety, ledger, telemetry, CLI, and project scope
classification.live_runtime_proof: PROVEN — current OMP-primary dogfood records all four outcomes through existing CLI/ledger/telemetry
classification.cross_harness_target: PROVEN — bounded Python contract/CLI is harness-neutral and composed with a real OMP worker path
classification.token_economic_requirement: PROVEN — review operation is local (0 review model calls); complexity measured as 11 LOC to 7 LOC for dead-wrapper cleanup; no fabricated token savings
classification.dogfood_requirement: PROVEN — simplify, reuse, defer, no_action, worker path, recovery, dedupe, and resolution exercised
classification.promotion_acceptance_gates: PROVEN — verification gate, fail-safe debt handling, ledger/telemetry mirroring, and independent reconstruction

reviews.metrics: before 11 LOC / after 7 LOC; 4 LOC removed

critical_debt_lifecycle.new_session_recovery: p35-dogfood-recover re-recorded the same deferred hash; exactly one debt row remained
critical_debt_lifecycle.resolution: p35-dogfood-resolve marked the same ID resolved

safety.speculative_cleanup: defer records debt instead of forcing cleanup
safety.dedupe: stable DEBT ID updates existing row
safety.resolution: resolved status preserves debt identity, rationale, and evidence
safety.corrupt_file: BrainError without overwriting corrupt debt file
safety.project_scope: same debt identity writes to separate project roots without leakage

verification.ledger_telemetry: simplification_review event mirrored in ledger and telemetry; bounded payload only
